description: This file contains UI test cases for the ForYouScreen component in an Android app, using Jetpack Compose testing framework. It tests loading states, topic selection, and feed display behaviors.

classes.name: ForYouScreenTest
classes.description: Test class for the ForYouScreen composable, verifying loading states, topic selection, and feed display.

methods.name: circularProgressIndicator_whenScreenIsLoading_exists
methods.description: Tests that a loading indicator appears when the screen is in loading state.

methods.name: circularProgressIndicator_whenScreenIsSyncing_exists
methods.description: Tests that a loading indicator appears when the screen is syncing.

methods.name: topicSelector_whenNoTopicsSelected_showsTopicChipsAndDisabledDoneButton
methods.description: Verifies topic chips are shown and the Done button is disabled when no topics are selected.

methods.name: topicSelector_whenSomeTopicsSelected_showsTopicChipsAndEnabledDoneButton
methods.description: Verifies topic chips are shown and the Done button is enabled when some topics are selected.

methods.name: feed_whenInterestsSelectedAndLoading_showsLoadingIndicator
methods.description: Checks that a loading indicator is shown when interests are selected and feed is loading.

methods.name: feed_whenNoInterestsSelectionAndLoading_showsLoadingIndicator
methods.description: Checks that a loading indicator is shown when no interests are selected and feed is loading.

methods.name: feed_whenNoInterestsSelectionAndLoaded_showsFeed
methods.description: Verifies that the feed is displayed when loading is complete and no interests are selected.
